card.title: I Can Handle This
card.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm ready for our audition results. Why are you breathing like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Four in, six out. I like to arrive already regulated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Lend me your pen; my support network deserves advance notice.

mechanism: A claims readiness while immediately adopting B's breathing and support-list methods as established personal preparation.
confusable: Unlike openly learning coping skills, A must conceal dependence on each new clue beneath complete readiness.
comparison: D114-a borrows a pen after borrowing a breathing pattern; D114-b borrows water and a reader for a rejection email.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
